capabilities.name: model.build
capabilities.description: Build a parametric 3D model from a structured spec and export it to STEP and STL. Deterministic: the spec fully determines the geometry, and no model class is consulted.

input_schema.description: The node contract carries payloads as a flat map of string to string, so every slot below is a STRING - including 'spec', which is a JSON object encoded as a string rather than a nested object.

spec.description: JSON object encoded as a string: {"shape": "box|cylinder|plate|bracket|flange", "dimensions_mm": {...}, "features": [...]}. All lengths are millimetres. Features by shape: box/plate/bracket take {"type":"hole","diameter_mm":8,"at_mm":[20,0]}; cylinder takes {"type":"bore","diameter_mm":20}; flange takes {"type":"bolt_holes","count":8,"diameter_mm":14}, {"type":"fillet","radius_mm":4} and {"type":"chamfer","size_mm":2}.

formats.description: Comma-separated subset of 'step,stl'. Defaults to both.

name.description: Base filename for the exported artifacts. Defaults to 'model'.

output_schema.description: Also a flat map of string to string; numeric values are decimal strings and booleans are 'true'/'false'.

step_path.description: Absolute path to the exported STEP file.

stl_path.description: Absolute path to the exported STL file.

validation_error.description: Present only when the model exported but could not be measured; the files are still valid.

renders.description: How many orthographic previews were produced, e.g. '3/3' or '0/3 (renderer unavailable)'. A headless host produces none, which never fails a build.

script_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the generated CadQuery script, so a build is reproducible from its inputs.
